source.description: DEV-only dynamic background derived from the original farm candidate; the enclosed plot beds are cleared to natural grass for runtime-owned soil and crops.

intendedUse: DEV visual direction candidate only. Do not register in production asset manifests or treat as a collision-aligned playable map.

supersededStudies.reason: Initial three-quarter 3:2 composition was superseded because it did not match the map's 4:3 aspect ratio or orthogonal grid preview needs.

landmarks: enclosed empty tilled beds in the lower-left area
connected paths to all four map edges and around each building and field
stream and dock along the southeast edge
dense foliage and rock borders around the perimeter
composition.gameplayAlignment: Image aspect matches the farm 4:3 world. Layout includes collision-backed water scenery, reachable greenhouse entry and return door, and aligned crop/shipping areas. Candidate remains DEV-only and awaits per-tile visual gameplay verification.

composite_reference.role: visual reference only; runtime plots replace the former tilled beds
